_help: How this project runs each exit gate from the gate library (shared/references/context/loop-controls.md). scaffold-project.sh and /bmad:onboard fill `run` from the build files via `bmad-gate.py detect --write` and mark it `"detected": true`; the Tech Lead reviews every command at sprint planning, drops the flag and fills any gap. `run` = a shell command whose exit 0 means the gate passed. `verdict: true` means the gate is satisfied by the review engine's GO for the same commit — ac-checklist is a judgment call, so the reviewer decides it, never the actor. An empty `run` is `missing_project_gate` until the TL declares it. Add a project-specific gate with `"custom": true`.
